items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.excerpt: Instead of computing pixels, Claude Fable 5.2 writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application — a code-driven painting pipeline rather than a diffusion image model.
items.rationale: A new way to make images: code-driven brushstroke painting instead of diffusion. The brief assigns this creative-tool angle to design.

items.title: Config India 2026: Figma deep dive: Nothing lost in translation, from canvas to production
items.excerpt: Deep dive on closing the prototype-to-production gap with design-system context, advanced MCP techniques, code layers and specs in Figma.
items.rationale: Hands-on Figma session on MCP, code layers and specs that designers can apply to handoff tomorrow. It is a separate Config India session from the 11-12 card.

items.title: AI's Role in the Creative Process
items.excerpt: Figma examines which parts of the creative process designers are willing to hand to AI and which they insist on keeping for themselves.
items.rationale: Figma's own account of which creative tasks designers hand to AI and which they keep. Useful for deciding where to automate.

items.title: AI makes scanned buildings searchable
items.excerpt: qentin uses AI to make reality-captured buildings searchable, letting facility managers find assets, check safety features and explore digital twins by query.
items.rationale: New product that lets people search reality-capture scans and digital twins with natural-language queries. A concrete AEC/CAD workflow change.

items.title: SimScale launches Engineering AI Blueprint
items.excerpt: SimScale's Engineering AI Blueprint bundles NVIDIA tools and a framework for moving AI-driven simulation and design-engineering workflows from pilots to broader deployment.
items.rationale: New launch that packages AI simulation for design-engineering teams moving past pilots. It comes from an on-whitelist CAD outlet.
